item.text:
No. Although Postgres accepts and propagates `IngestContext` and `RetrievalContext`, it does not derive query scope from them. Unlike Vespa, it does not apply `group_id` or `yql_filter`; queries can see the full collection. citeturn1view0

For tenant isolation, use separate collections/tables or apply filtering before querying the Postgres store. The backends share pipeline interfaces, but their query-scoping behavior differs. [Postgres backend documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres)
